components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main booking or route action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--signal, #d8ff3e); color: var(--ink, #071b14); font: 800 1rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 rgba(7,27,20,.36); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--sun, #ffb51b); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(7,27,20,.42); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #d8ff3e); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A direct secondary command on dark photography.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(248,250,243,.72); border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(7,27,20,.42); color: #fff; font: 800 1rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--signal, #d8ff3e); background: var(--forest, #0b3524); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #d8ff3e); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: The standard booking and contact field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink, #071b14); font: 800 .9rem/1.3 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #071b14); border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #071b14); font: 400 1rem/1.4 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #d8ff3e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Route Filter
components.description: A three-way trek category selector with a single active route.
components.css: .ds-route-filter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); border: 2px solid var(--steel, #b9c3ba); } .ds-route-filter button { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--steel, #b9c3ba); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #fff; font: 800 .9rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-route-filter button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-route-filter .is-active { background: var(--signal, #d8ff3e); color: var(--ink, #071b14); } .ds-route-filter button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #d8ff3e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Route Card
components.description: A factual trek summary connected to the continuous route spine.
components.html:
ROUTE 03

2-DAY JUNGLE TREKKING

120 EUR pp

Sleep by the river, with guide, meals, tent, and permits included.
components.css: .ds-route-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .8fr 1.2fr; min-height: 260px; border: 2px solid var(--steel, #b9c3ba); background: var(--surface, #f8faf3); color: var(--ink, #071b14); } .ds-route-photo { min-height: 260px; background: var(--forest, #0b3524); } .ds-route-copy { padding: 28px; } .ds-route-copy span { display: inline-block; padding: 5px 8px; background: var(--clay, #a84322); color: #fff; font: 800 .76rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-route-copy h3 { margin: 18px 0 10px; font: 700 2.2rem/.98 var(--font-display, sans-serif); } .ds-route-copy strong { color: var(--clay, #a84322); } .ds-route-copy p { max-width: 48ch; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Field Navigation
components.description: The fixed dark route rail with one high-visibility action.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 68px; align-items: center; gap: 22px; padding: 0 10px 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(216,255,62,.36); background: rgba(7,27,20,.96); color: #fff; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 rgba(7,27,20,.24); font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; color: var(--signal, #d8ff3e); } .ds-nav a { color: rgba(248,250,243,.78); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--signal, #d8ff3e); } .ds-nav button { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--signal, #d8ff3e); color: var(--ink, #071b14); font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #d8ff3e); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The interface borrows its authority from rainforest fieldwork: numbered trail tags, waterproof route charts, measured observation, and equipment made to be read outdoors. Real photography supplies emotion and proof; the system around it supplies orientation. The visual world stays useful across persuasive, booking, and editorial surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Strong black structural rules and measured grid alignment.
High-visibility field colors used as functional signals.
Route lines, trail tags, and coordinates that carry real information.
Direct, human copy grounded in Bukit Lawang.

rules.name: The Field Signal Rule
rules.body: Bright colors mark action, route, or state. They are never scattered as decoration.

rules.name: The Contrast Pair Rule
rules.body: River Bright always carries Canopy Ink; River Ink is the text-safe blue on light surfaces.

rules.name: The Outdoor Read Rule
rules.body: Headings stay bold and compact, body copy stays generous, and no text crosses a structural route line.

rules.name: The Equipment Rule
rules.body: Surfaces feel printed, tagged, clipped, or mounted, not softly floating.

dos: Do use real forest, wildlife, guide, camp, and river imagery as proof.
Do connect sections with a meaningful route or field-marker sequence.
Do make prices, duration, intensity, and booking actions easy to compare.
Do keep wildlife language ethical and avoid implied guarantees.
Do preserve 44px minimum targets and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't build pages from repeated generic icon cards.
Don't use field notation as decorative jargon.
Don't soften the system into beige eco-luxury styling.
Don't put cards inside cards; use rules and lists inside framed tools.
Don't let graphic expression obscure the route to booking or WhatsApp.
